g.text: pull_request workflow has no `concurrency` group: pushing new commits
add: concurrency: { group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true }
job `test` has no timeout-minutes (default is 360): one hung step can
set timeout-minutes to a little above the job's normal duration, e.g. timeout-minutes: 15
job `test` runs on macos-latest (10x billing multiplier) on every
run expensive runners on a filtered trigger (release tags, paths) or behind a Linux smoke test
actions/setup-node without `cache:` input re-downloads dependencies on
add `with: { cache: npm (or yarn/pnpm) }` to cache the package manager's downloads
job `build` has no timeout-minutes (default is 360): one hung step can
set timeout-minutes to a little above the job's normal duration, e.g. timeout-minutes: 15
checkout with fetch-depth: 0 clones full history; on large repos this
only fetch full history if the job truly needs it (e.g. changelog/semantic-release); otherwise drop
actions/setup-node without `cache:` input re-downloads dependencies on
add `with: { cache: npm (or yarn/pnpm) }` to cache the package manager's downloads
artifact uploaded with default 90-day retention; storage accumulates on
set with: { retention-days: 7 } (or what you actually need)
